items.title: Owners approve Arctos purchasing a limited stake in the Falcons
items.text: NFL owners approved Arctos' purchase of a limited stake in the Falcons on Tuesday, the team announced.

items.text: NFL, Eagles were and are in lockstep on situation that has many unanswered questions.

items.title: Falcons release LB Bralen Trice
items.text: With word emerging earlier on Tuesday that the Falcons were adding linebacker Charles Snowden, Atlanta has opened a roster spot.

items.title: Cowboys sign QB Kyle Trask to their practice squad
items.text: The Cowboys needed a third quarterback after losing Joe Milton off their practice squad.

items.title: On the day his six-game suspension ended, Jed York attends quarterly NFL ownership meeting
items.text: On the same day his six-game suspension following an August arrest in Ohio ended, 49ers owner Jed York was present at the quarterly gathering of the most exclusive club in American sports.

items.title: Panthers waive OT Albert Reese
items.text: The Panthers waived offensive tackle Albert Reese, the team announced Tuesday.

items.title: Cowboys LB DeMarvion Overshown says he will return to the lineup this week
items.text: The Cowboys won't have Dee Winters this week after the linebacker strained his Achilles in the loss to the Packers.

items.title: Colts add WR Mecole Hardman, P Thomas Morstead to practice squad
items.text: After firing General Manager Chris Ballard on Monday, the Colts have added a couple of depth pieces to their greater roster.

items.title: Terry McLaurin out for year with torn patellar tendon
items.text: McLaurin was injured in Monday night's loss to the 49ers.

items.title: Patriots don't expect Ben Brown, Alijah Vera-Tucker to play on Thursday
items.text: The Patriots saw three of their starting offensive linemen go down with injuries during last Sunday's win over the Jets and it looks like they'll be without at least two of them when they face the Bears on Thursday.

items.title: Dan Campbell: I expect Kerby Joseph to play this year, but no timetable
items.text: The Lions are set to have Brian Branch in the lineup for the first time this season when they face the Packers on Sunday, but they're still waiting for another one of their safeties to get back on the field.

items.title: Dolphins sign Rodney McGraw to 53-man roster
items.text: The Dolphins have announced a few roster moves on Tuesday.

items.title: Zach Sieler: I love it here, I want to win as a Dolphin
items.text: The Dolphins parted ways with a lot of veteran players heading into the 2026 season, but defensive tackle Zach Sieler was not one of them.

items.title: Brian Flores declines to discuss Korn Ferry document that was made public last week
items.text: Vikings defensive coordinator wisely avoids talking about the case.

items.title: The no-sleep issue is just another confusing part of the Jalen Hurts story
items.text: The absence of complete information about the events that led to Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts traveling to London with a blood clot in his leg, playing with a blood clot in his leg, and promptly traveling back to Philadelphia with a blood clot in his leg has resulted in plenty of reports aimed at filling the gaps.

items.title: Report: Umpire Larry Smith out for season after slipping on Wembley Stadium grass
items.text: NFL official Larry Smith suffered a season-ending injury on Sunday in London.

items.title: Saints arrive in Paris for Sunday's game against Steelers
items.text: Amid ongoing local unrest that has sparked full-blown riots, the NFL is pushing forward with its first-ever game in Paris.

items.text: The Falcons are adding an edge rusher to the roster.

items.title: With Matthew Stafford's next loss, he ties Vinny Testaverde for the most QB losses ever

items.title: Todd Monken: We're better with Jerry Jeudy than we are without him
items.text: Jerry Jeudy has ostensibly been passed on Cleveland's depth chart by the team's rookie receivers, KC Concepcion and Denzel Boston.

items.title: Giants will release Najee Harris
items.text: On Sunday, Giants running back Najee Harris expressed concern about the distribution of touches in the team's ground game.

items.title: Rams plan to replace K Blake Grupe in next day or two
items.text: In his first, and only, game with the Rams, kicker Blake Grupe suffered a torn ACL while making a tackle during a kick return.

items.title: Dan Campbell: Penei Sewell's switch to left tackle has been outstanding
items.text: During the offseason, the Lions elected to move three-time first-team AP All-Pro Penei Sewell from right tackle to left tackle.

items.title: Rams WR Davante Adams out 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring

items.title: What's next for Dan Quinn?
